item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Night Market Event Pack

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

item.tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
answer_sheet.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
answer_sheet.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
answer_sheet.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

must_haves: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.

turns.text: Could you make me a matching event pack with a poster, a vertical story image and a vertical reel that all look like they belong together? I’m excited about this event, and having the visuals together will make it feel a bit more real to me. The poster should be 4:5 and the reel should be 10 seconds long, and all three need to say Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. For the look, please use warm lanterns with midnight blue and gold. I always worry that I’ll get caught up in how pretty something looks and forget whether people can actually read it. Please keep the reel text easy to read.
turns.agent:
The midnight-blue-and-gold direction will work beautifully for this. **Magic Hour refused the first generation because the account has insufficient credits, so no files were created.** I can’t provide download links yet.

Here’s the coordinated design plan, ready to use once credits are available:

| Asset | Format | Design |
|---|---|---|
| Poster | 4:5 | Warm lantern border, midnight-blue center, large gold-and-ivory text |
| Story | 9:16 | Same typography and artwork, with generous top and bottom safe margins |
| Reel | 9:16, 10 seconds | Same layout, with gentle lantern movement around a stationary text panel |

**Exact wording on all three:**
> Lantern Night Market  
> 18 September 2027  
> 6–10 PM  
> Riverside Yard  
> Free entry

For readability, the reel should show **all five details from the first frame through the full 10 seconds**—no scrolling, rotating text, or delayed reveals. The lanterns can provide the atmosphere while the information stays still and clear.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a polished, highly readable vertical event announcement, 9:16. Cohesive palette: deep midnight blue #101D35, warm antique gold #EBC777, soft ivory #FFF3D6. Warm glowing paper lanterns hang across the upper edges; delicate gold linework and tiny riverside market silhouettes at the bottom edges. Sophisticated festive editorial typography, no clutter. Most of the central canvas is a solid midnight blue panel with NO imagery or texture behind the lettering. Large crisp high contrast centered lettering, generous line spacing and safe margins at least 12% all sides; keep all important text between 20% and 76% image height for story/reel UI safety. Title arranged on two lines, bold elegant display lettering; details in very clear bold sans serif. Include exactly the following words, spelled precisely, in this hierarchy: 'Lantern Night Market' / '18 September 2027' / '6–10 PM' / 'Riverside Yard' / 'Free entry'. The slashes indicate separate lines, do NOT print slashes. Title largest, date and time next largest, venue clearly prominent, Free entry as a distinct gold outlined badge. All five text elements must be large and easily readable on a phone. Restrained beautiful lantern border, flat front-facing graphic design, not a photo of a poster, no extra words, no logos.
